title: 003 四叔

content_zh:
她连忙低下头, 却是晚了一步, 对方探究的视线一直围绕着她, 让她有种被他看穿的错觉。
无疑, 这是个危险的男人！
只是他怎么在这？他是谁？和原身是什么关系？他知不知道昨晚的女人是她？
如水底垂落, 许多疑惑在苏檀心里一点点蔓延荡漾，搅得她心神不宁。
而对面的封京墨放下碗，解开纽扣, 如某的双眸微眯，琢磨着对面这女人刚才的表情。
他分明在她眼里看到了惊讶，属于商人的直觉让封京墨顿生怀疑, 眉头当下轻蹙。
苏檀为什么会露出这种表情？难不成昨晚的女人真是她？
不, 想到一事，封京墨否定了这个猜测。
“我们见过？”封京墨语气淡漠。
见全桌人看向自己, 苏檀才明白对面这个气场强大的男人在问自己, 对方只一眼, 就看出她的不对, 实在是个心思缜密却又难缠的对象。
她垂眸摇头：“没。”
“苏檀。”老爷子对苏檀一向温和, 他笑道：“你应该没见过京墨, 他常年在国外生活，你嫁进来后还没见过他，别看他年纪不大, 论起来你也该和陵游一样, 叫一声四叔。”
四叔……
苏檀眼眉低垂，差点把脸埋在碗里，面色看似平静，心里却掀起惊涛骇浪。
四叔？她心里有一句mmp不知当讲不当讲，这世界是不是太玄幻了？穿越到一个陌生时空就罢了，一穿来就419这操作是不是太骚了？419就罢了，对象还是自己老公的四叔！
这穿越，够酸爽！
“苏檀？”
“啊？”苏檀回神，这才意识到所有人都在等自己，退无可退，她在全桌人的注视下，低声喃喃：“四叔……”
封京墨依旧靠在椅背上，表情淡淡，眉头却不觉挑了一下，她声音很小，听起来没有刚才怼人的气势，反而十分温顺，但不知为何，他莫名有种感觉，这些都是表象，隐藏在她温顺外表下的，是一颗不屈的心。
封京墨的手指在餐桌上随意敲了几下，声音说不出的慵懒：

“嗯。”
饭后，老爷子把封陵游叫进去说了几句，之后白薇委委屈屈地走了。
苏檀听说后，理了下原身的回忆。
在这个家里，封老爷子和封老太太对她都算不错的，从不为难她这个孙媳妇，哪怕她没有娘家人依靠，也不像蒋蓉芳那般对她百般刁难，平日对她也算和气，像封家这样的家庭，是最重规矩的，在外面乱来可以，要是扰了秩序，自然是不被允许的，他们就算不站在苏檀这边，却也不会容许封陵游抹黑封家。
苏檀回到房间洗了个澡，水冲在她的身体上，让她所有感官瞬间苏醒，脑子里翻来覆去都是昨夜的疯狂，因吃了药，那般不自制的两人，竟然会在同一空间内共处，实在有些玄幻，只是不知道这个封京墨是否认出她来。
苏檀心里没底，只好将这些想法抛之脑后，洗完澡，她站在镜子中打量自己，真觉得这世界十分玄幻。
她所处的世界应该是这边平行空间，她也是华国人，一切和这边的世界并无两样，只是科技比这边发达许多，在她的国家，曾经有个阶段，国人非常推崇西医，弃中医，认为中医都是骗人的，中医治不好病，对西医的推崇导致国民大量滥用抗生素，人们的体质一代不如一代，再加上各种新型疾病的肆虐，使得政府不得推出条令，推行中医养生，多年努力后，西医压过中医的局面才得以改变，中医得到全国人的信任，神医辈出，她就是出生在这样的黄金时代，作为和原身一样的中医世家传人，她没有落得苏家这种悲惨地步，反而因为家族出神医，受到推崇，她苏檀在穿来之前，更是赢得国医称号，为国家领导人看病调理身体，只没想到，一直想着为国做贡献的她在尝试新的中草药时，中了毒，之后就来了这里。
而眼下这个国家对中医也并不重视，中医黑很多，人们总认为中医调理下身体还行，治病就别出场了，怎么看都像是她那个国家盲目推崇西医的阶段。
殊不知，长此以往，人们将为此付出很沉重的代价。
苏檀看着镜中的自己。
镜中的人有一头乌黑卷曲的头发，刘海斜斜耷拉在一旁，衬得本就精致的脸更为耐看，她的五官生的极美，薄唇轻抿时有种说不出的淡漠，可笑起来却又让人心头一亮，有种说不出的矛盾美。

content_en:
She quickly lowered her head, but it was a step too late. The other party's probing eyes kept surrounding her, giving her the illusion that he had seen through her.
There is no doubt that this is a dangerous man!
But why is he here? who is he? What is the relationship with the original body? Does he know that she was the woman last night?
Like the bottom of the water, many doubts spread and rippled in Su Tan's heart, making her uneasy.
Feng Jingmo, who was opposite him, put down his bowl and unbuttoned his buttons. Rumou narrowed his eyes slightly, pondering the expression of the woman opposite him just now.
He clearly saw surprise in her eyes, and his businessman's intuition suddenly made Feng Jingmo suspicious, and he frowned slightly.
Why did Su Tan show such an expression? Could it be that the woman last night was really her?
No, after thinking of something, Feng Jingmo denied this guess.
"Have we met?" Feng Jingmo said indifferently.
Seeing everyone at the table looking at her, Su Tan realized that the powerful man opposite her was asking her question. With just one glance, he could see that there was something wrong with her. She was really a thoughtful but difficult person.
She lowered her eyes and shook her head: "No."
"Su Tan." The old man was always gentle to Su Tan. He smiled and said, "You probably haven't met Jing Mo. He lives abroad all year round. You haven't seen him since you got married. Even though he is not old, you should be called Fourth Uncle like Ling You."
Fourth uncle...
Su Tan lowered his eyebrows and almost buried his face in the bowl. His face seemed calm, but there was a turmoil in his heart.
Fourth uncle? There was something in her mind that she didn't know whether to say or not. Is this world too fantasy? It's just a matter of traveling to a strange time and space. Isn't this operation too saucy? Just 419, the target is still my husband’s fourth uncle!
This time travel is so sour and refreshing!
"Su Tan?"
"Ah?" Su Tan came to her senses and realized that everyone was waiting for her and there was no way to retreat. Under the gaze of everyone at the table, she murmured in a low voice: "Fourth uncle..."
Feng Jingmo was still leaning on the back of the chair, her expression was calm, but her brows were raised unconsciously. Her voice was very low, and she didn't sound as arrogant as before, but very docile. But for some reason, he had an inexplicable feeling that these were just appearances. Hidden under her docile appearance was an unyielding heart.
Feng Jingmo tapped his fingers on the dining table a few times, and his voice was indescribably lazy:
"Yeah."
After the meal, the old man called Fenglingyou in to say a few words, and then Bai Wei left aggrievedly.
After Su Tan heard about it, he sorted out his original memories.
In this family, Mr. Feng and Mrs. Feng were both kind to her. They never made things difficult for her granddaughter-in-law, even if she had no family to rely on. They did not make things difficult for her like Jiang Rongfang. They were usually kind to her. A family like the Feng family was the most disciplined. It was okay to mess around outside. Naturally, if it disturbed the order, it was not allowed. Even if they did not side with Su Tan, they would not allow Feng Lingyou to smear the Feng family.
Su Tan returned to the room and took a shower. The water rushed over her body, instantly awakening all her senses. The madness of last night was turning over in her mind. Because of the medicine, two people who were so uncontrollable could actually coexist in the same space. It was a bit fantasy, but she didn't know if Feng Jingmo recognized her.
Su Tan was unsure, so she had to put these thoughts behind her. After taking a bath, she stood in the mirror and looked at herself. She really felt that the world was very mysterious.
The world she lives in should be this parallel space. She is also Chinese. Everything is the same as the world here, but the technology is much more advanced than here. In her country, there was a stage when the Chinese people highly respected Western medicine and abandoned Chinese medicine. They believed that Chinese medicine was a lie and that Chinese medicine could not cure diseases. The admiration for Western medicine led to the excessive abuse of antibiotics by the people. People's physiques deteriorated from generation to generation. Coupled with the raging of various new diseases, the government was unable toAfter issuing regulations and promoting traditional Chinese medicine for health care, after many years of hard work, the situation of Western medicine overpowering traditional Chinese medicine was changed. Traditional Chinese medicine gained the trust of people all over the country, and miracle doctors emerged in large numbers. She was born in such a golden age. As a descendant of a family of traditional Chinese medicine like her original body, she did not end up in the tragic situation of the Su family. It was a tragic situation, but she was highly regarded because of her family's miracle doctor. Before she came here, she, Su Tan, had won the title of national doctor and treated the country's leaders to treat their bodies. Unexpectedly, she, who had always wanted to contribute to the country, was poisoned while trying new Chinese herbal medicines, and then came here.
At present, this country does not pay much attention to traditional Chinese medicine. Traditional Chinese medicine has a lot of negative reputations. People always think that traditional Chinese medicine can regulate the body and be okay, but it should not play a role in treating diseases. No matter how you look at it, it looks like the stage of her country's blind respect for Western medicine.
As everyone knows, in the long run, people will pay a heavy price for this.
Su Tan looked at herself in the mirror.
The person in the mirror has curly black hair, with bangs hanging sideways, which makes her already delicate face even more attractive. Her facial features are extremely beautiful, and there is an indescribable indifference to her thin lips when she purses them lightly. She is ridiculous but also makes people feel happy. There is an indescribable contradictory beauty.
